posts.text:
Five cities with estimated costs <=USD 1,800/month, site walkability >=7.5/10 and 2026 Q1 download >=200 Mbps.

Ranked by walkability, then download, highest first. Missing walk scores excluded.
posts.alt: City photos ranked by site walkability, then 2026 Q1 download speed, with monthly USD estimates: Prague 8.8/10, 252.9 Mbps, 1,800; Budapest 8.5/10, 344.5 Mbps, 1,400; Osaka 8.5/10, 210.5 Mbps, 1,800; Taipei 8/10, 259.7 Mbps, 1,800; Porto 7.8/10, 359.9 Mbps, 1,800. Filters: walkability at least 7.5, download at least 200 Mbps, cost no more than USD 1,800. Missing walk scores excluded.

posts.text:
1. Prague, Czech Republic: site walkability 8.8/10; USD 1,800/month estimated.

2026 Q1 broadband snapshot: 252.9 down / 153.9 up Mbps. Highest walk score among cities passing all three filters.
posts.alt: Prague, Czech Republic, photo and directory metrics. Site walkability: 8.8/10. Estimated monthly cost: USD 1,800. Fixed-broadband snapshot for 2026 Q1: 252.9 Mbps download and 153.9 Mbps upload.

posts.text:
2. Budapest, Hungary: site walkability 8.5/10; estimated USD 1,400/month, USD 400 below the ceiling.

2026 Q1 broadband snapshot: 344.5 down / 165.3 up Mbps. Download breaks the walk-score tie with Osaka.
posts.alt: Budapest, Hungary, photo and directory metrics. Site walkability: 8.5/10. Estimated monthly cost: USD 1,400. Fixed-broadband snapshot for 2026 Q1: 344.5 Mbps download and 165.3 Mbps upload.

posts.text:
3. Osaka, Japan: site walkability 8.5/10; USD 1,800/month estimated.

2026 Q1 broadband snapshot: 210.5 down / 175.2 up Mbps. Same walk score as Budapest, with lower download but 9.9 Mbps higher upload.
posts.alt: Osaka, Japan, photo and directory metrics. Site walkability: 8.5/10. Estimated monthly cost: USD 1,800. Fixed-broadband snapshot for 2026 Q1: 210.5 Mbps download and 175.2 Mbps upload.

posts.text:
4. Taipei, Taiwan: site walkability 8/10 and transit 8.8/10; USD 1,800/month estimated.

2026 Q1 broadband snapshot: 259.7 down / 166.8 up Mbps.
posts.alt: Taipei, Taiwan, photo and directory metrics. Site walkability: 8/10; transit: 8.8/10. Estimated monthly cost: USD 1,800. Fixed-broadband snapshot for 2026 Q1: 259.7 Mbps download and 166.8 Mbps upload.

posts.text:
5. Porto, Portugal: site walkability 7.8/10; USD 1,800/month estimated.

2026 Q1 broadband snapshot: 359.9 down / 225.5 up Mbps. Fastest download of these five; fifth in the walkability-first ranking.
